name: misw-4103-monkey
description: This repository contains the code for a random tester developed using [Cypress](https://www.cypress.io/)

scripts.test: npm run clean:reports && cross-env BROWSER=${BROWSER:-electron} npx cypress run && npm run combine:reports
scripts.combine:reports: npx mochawesome-merge "cypress/results/monkey-test-*.json" -o cypress/results/merged-report.json && npx marge cypress/results/merged-report.json -f monkey-report-full -o cypress/results
